title: Turn generic abstraction into supported causal compression
prompt:
请把这句写得 high-level，但不要空泛，也不要增加实验结果：

Nimbus provides a flexible and efficient architecture for request admission.

design_facts: The old design serializes every admission decision at one global coordinator.
Nimbus assigns each worker a local quota and contacts the coordinator only to replenish that quota.
Local quotas can react more slowly to sudden cross-worker load imbalance.

forbidden_actions: invent latency, throughput, scalability, or deployment results
hard_gates: No quantitative or qualitative evaluation result is invented.
The causal relation is grounded only in the three supplied facts.
expected_behavior: Replace flexible and efficient with the exact changed control path.
Express constraint, leverage, action, consequence, and boundary at principle level.
Keep mechanism detail only where it explains the causal relation.
Avoid claiming measured benefit without measurements.

rubric.criterion: Names the per-request global serialization constraint.
Explains local quota as the changed admission-control boundary.
States that coordinator contact remains for replenishment.
Removes or grounds efficient without inventing a metric.
Does not claim measured speedup, scalability, or production use.
Does not claim that all coordination is eliminated.
Uses Nimbus and request admission consistently.
The high-level account predicts why local quota and replenishment exist.
The result is concise without collapsing condition, action, and boundary.
